Common.footerText: An Arabic-first transport and logistics request platform for Saudi Arabia.

Home.metaTitle: Naqlia | Request transport in Riyadh and across Saudi cities
Home.metaDescription: Submit a furniture moving or cargo request in minutes. Naqlia reviews every request before preparing the right quotation.
Home.title: Every reliable move starts with a clear request
Home.subtitle: Choose a service, set the pickup and delivery locations, and share the details. Our team reviews every request before preparing a quotation.
Home.servicesDescription: Services come directly from Naqlia's managed catalog and are reviewed against your route and cargo details.
Home.process1Title: Tell us what you need moved
Home.process1Description: Choose one core service and any optional services.
Home.process2Description: Provide pickup, delivery, cargo details, and optional photos.
Home.process3Description: A sales representative validates the details before sending a quotation.
Home.finalDescription: Your progress is saved automatically so you can complete it from your phone in minutes.
Home.catalogError: The service catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

Request.metaDescription: Send a transport service request to Naqlia in five clear and secure steps.
Request.title: Tell us about your transport needs
Request.subtitle: Five short steps, with progress saved on this device until you finish.
Request.step1Description: Select one core service, then add any optional services you need.
Request.noOptions: No optional services are currently available for this service.
Request.step2Description: Enter a clear address. You can add your current coordinates to keep the request ready for maps and future routing.
Request.addressPlaceholder: District, street, building number, and nearest landmark
Request.locationUnavailable: We could not access your location. You can continue with the written address.
Request.step3Description: Describe the items clearly to help our sales team review the request.
Request.cargoPlaceholder: Example: complete bedroom set, dining table, and six chairs
Request.photosHint: Up to 4 JPEG, PNG, or WebP images, maximum 8 MB each.
Request.filesNotRestored: For your privacy, selected photos are not restored automatically after refreshing the page.
Request.step4Description: We use these details only to review and follow up on this request.
Request.notesPlaceholder: Preferred contact times or information that may help our team
Request.step5Description: Check the details. You can go back to any step to make changes.
Request.photoCount: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {One photo} other {# photos}}
Request.consent: I agree that my information and attachments may be used to review this request and contact me as described in the privacy notice.
Request.submissionHint: Submitting a request does not calculate a price or charge you.

errors.addressLength: Enter a clear address of at least 8 characters.
errors.sameAddress: Delivery must be different from pickup.
errors.cargoDescription: Enter a cargo description of at least 5 characters.
errors.quantity: Enter a whole number greater than zero or leave this blank.
errors.fullName: Enter a name of at least 2 characters.
errors.mobile: Enter a valid Saudi mobile number starting with 05.
errors.email: Enter a valid email address or leave this blank.
errors.consent: Accept the privacy notice before sending the request.
errors.fileType: This file type is not supported.
errors.fileSize: The image is larger than 8 MB.
errors.fileCount: You can add up to 4 images.
errors.uploadFailed: The images could not be uploaded securely. No request was created; please try again.
errors.invalidRequest: Review the highlighted information and try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: The request could not be sent right now. Your progress is safe; please try again shortly.

Success.title: Your request has been received
Success.description: A sales representative will review the details and contact you before preparing the final quotation.
Success.referenceHint: Keep this reference when contacting us.
Success.invalidReference: We could not display a valid reference. Return home and start a new request if you have not already submitted one.
Success.whatsappMessage: Hello Naqlia, I would like to ask about request {reference}.
Success.trackingMessage: Hello Naqlia, I would like to track request {reference}.

StaffAuth.title: Sign in to Naqlia
StaffAuth.description: Use your approved staff email. We will send a one-time secure sign-in link; no shared password is required.
StaffAuth.success: Check your inbox and open the secure link in this browser to continue.
StaffAuth.acceptError: This invitation is invalid or has expired. Request a new secure sign-in link.
StaffAuth.errorInvalidEmail: Enter a valid staff email address.
StaffAuth.errorUnavailable: We could not send the secure link. Confirm the account is provisioned and try again.

SalesWorkspace.noActivity: No activity has been recorded yet.

Privacy.title: Service request privacy notice
Privacy.intro: This short notice explains how information submitted through the service request form is used.
Privacy.collectionBody: We collect contact details, pickup and delivery addresses, cargo details, and any photos you choose to attach.
Privacy.purposeBody: We use the information to review your request, contact you, prepare an appropriate quotation, and support delivery if approved.
Privacy.storageBody: Attachments are stored privately and are not published. Access is limited by authorization and operational purpose.
Privacy.choiceBody: Email and photos are optional. We cannot review a request without a name, mobile number, route addresses, and cargo description.
